reason: We do library storytime, parks and the zoo, and I almost never pay for kid stuff. I'd take the free first visit to look, but $13 a kid plus a sibling on top is more than I'd spend when a rainy day at Ocean City's playground is a once-a-year thing.
objection: It sounds like CoCo's Funhouse with nicer decor, and I can get the same hour free at the library or the park. Paying $20+ for two kids every time doesn't make sense for me.
would_change_my_mind: A drop-in around $8 a kid, or a real reason it beats free options on bad-weather days, like a punch pass I could use only when it rains.
